title: Grisaia no Kajitsu: Grisaia no Tokuten
justification: AniList: 6 shorts of 3 min, 2014-12-26 to 2015-05-27 (the first one day after AniDB's 2014-12-25). AniDB 9749 S1-S6 on 2014-12-25, 2015-01-28, 02-25, 03-25, 04-22, 05-27. TVDB 281949 season 0 0x1-0x6, same dates: 1 "I'll Serve You, Pyon" = S1 Gohoushi Shichau Pyon; 2 "Michiru Edition 'How To Enjoy the Sea Tsundere-Style'" = S2 Tsundere Ryuu Umi no Tanoshimikata; 3 "I'll Wash Your Back" = S3 Osenaka, Onagashi Shimasu; 4 "Makina's Boot Camp" = S4; 5 "Summer Temptation" = S5 Natsu no Yuuwaku; 6 "Shall We Play Doctor?" = S6 Oisha-san Gokko Shimashou ka?. Same order. The parent has no mapping list; the neighbours on 281949 are AniDB 11008 (its AniDB S1 to 0x7) and 11009 (S1-S5 to 0x9-0x13), none claims 0x1-0x6.
